name: session.rollback
title: session.rollback
summary: Undo every transaction of this session after a checkpoint, all or nothing.
html:
Undo every transaction of this session after a checkpoint, all or nothing.

  • Scope: edit:scene
  • Service: core
  • MCP: ara_session with "action": "rollback"

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
sessionyesSession handle from session.begin.
toyesCheckpoint (cp_...) to return to. Every later transaction of this session is undone, all or nothing. Agent sessions get one checkpoint per turn.
